summary: Built interactive drag-and-drop workflow editor with NodePalette (HTML5 drag API for upload/extract/transform/output node types), SVG Canvas (pan, zoom, node dragging, connection drawing between ports), WorkflowNode component (type-specific icons, input/output ports, selection/error visual feedback), ConnectionLine component (bezier curves with valid=green/invalid=red/pending=yellow styling), useWorkflowEditor hook (useReducer-based state management for nodes, connections, selection, pending connections, and real-time validation), workflowValidation utility (connection type rules, cycle detection via DFS, orphan detection, user-friendly error messages), and WorkflowEditor container with validation sidebar. Added /workflow-editor route. All 32 validation tests pass, Vite build succeeds, zero type errors in new code.
